label: MacGuffin Clarity
description: Whether the driving object or goal is clear and motivates action.
usage: Clarify the driving object or goal if characters (or readers) lose track of why it matters.
chapter_instruction: Track the driving object or goal in this chapter. Fill only the required markdown headings below (use exactly those heading texts). Use short quotes or location cues. Write "none" under a heading if empty. Do not write the full-book report yet—chapter notes only.
final_instruction: Produce a MacGuffin Clarity report. Merge the chapter notes below into one author-facing markdown report for this analysis. Group patterns across chapters, cite chapter names, rank severity where useful, and do not invent manuscript details not supported by the notes.
